summary: Findings-only scientific fact-base audit of ALL NeuroAxis content (no product file touched). Wrote docs/audit/v19/facts.findings.json (70 findings, v15-compatible schema plus the brief's `subject` key) and docs/audit/v19/facts.md (verdict/severity table, per-area counts, measured tables, reproduction commands, stated limits). Coverage: 264 structure records / 20 files, 23 tracts, 26 syndrome cards, 15 plate manifests + 15 SVGs, 12 nerve courses in src/geometry/curves.ts, 39 authored + 4 built-in vessel courses in src/geometry/vasculature-courses.ts, cross-checked against levels.json, taxonomy.json, anatomy-manifest.json (138 parts), planeGeometry.ts/contours.ts conventions and docs/audit/v15. Measured (not opined): 3 critical findings (ACoA and PCA-thalamogeniculate supply[] wrongly linked to the tuberothalamic card - 0/3 territory hits each; plate-thalamus-mid's orientation frame inverted against its own drawn geometry, corr(SVG y, z)=+0.79); 12 major (built-in course supply[] ids that are not cards + the gate blind spot; AChA/STN/territory trilemma; 8 vessel origin3d anchors 2.4-16.6 au outside their own committed mesh bbox, ACoA 20 mm; v18 lenticulostriate split leaving three overlapping territory lists + a taxonomy synonym collision; 4 CN nuclei registered midline while every sibling is paired, all four CN III syndrome cards claiming ipsilateral deficits; nrv-cn2-optic vs tract-optic-nerve duplicate identity; syn-claude lighting the cerebellar dentate nucleus; 8/9 transverse plates drawn 180 degrees from the app's documented anterior-up canvas convention; 6 pontomedullary plates with corner-letter frames; README 40 courses/77 tubes vs the shipped merge function's 41/38/79 - the gate prints 79 in the same run). 24 ok findings document what was verified (Papez/basal-ganglia directions, hippocampal circuit, pyramidal decussation figures, nerve foramina, course radii 52/52 exact, plate slug/label/levelId integrity, 23/23 tract decussations, homunculus order + residuals). Verification: node -e contract command prints 'findings 70' and exits 0 (run); evidence contract files non-empty; every quoted fragment in `claimed` was machine-checked against the shipped corpus (68 quotes, 0 fabricated); gates corroborating the report re-run green (node scripts/verify/area-toggles.mjs exit 0 with 472 assertions). No files outside docs/audit/v19/facts.* were written (git status shows only that untracked directory plus other agents' files).
